advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Jesus the homeless hippy: Chris Olave for Jonathan Taylor.

reasons: You're 7-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 12%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 4th of 10 contenders (145.8 points a week).
Your weakest position is RB (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 12%, 19%, 18%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 12% to 14%, and your lineup comes out 0.4 points a week ahead overall. Chris Olave adds 4.6 points a week for you today, but Jonathan Taylor is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,796, get 4,599), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.3 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 19% and 18% to 20% and 18%.
You have 4 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 14 is your weakest projected week (155 points vs your usual 173), mostly byes.
Rhamondre Stevenson may be worth more now than later: age 28: RB values usually drop after this season.
Tank Dell may be worth more now than later: value 1,534 vs ~854 for 7.2 pts/wk of production.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 18% in 22 days.
Lamar Jackson's trade value has dropped 25% in 22 days.
advice.key: ["trade", "Make a trade", ["Offer Jesus the homeless hippy: Chris Olave for Jonathan Taylor."]]
